phase3.gigsHelp.en: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.gigsHelp.draft: Imisebenzi emfushane yasendaweni, hlola izimo ze-parole nesikhulu sakho, izinombolo zocingo aziboniswa.

phase3.housingHelp.en: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.housingHelp.draft: Imigomo yokonga kanye nohlelo lokulungela izindlu. Groundwork ayinikezi izindlu futhi ayihlanganyeli nabahlinzeki. Ukuze uthole usizo lwasendaweni, shayela 211.

phase3.paidNote.en: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.paidNote.draft: Uhlelo olukhokhelwayo. Akukho ntengo ebekiwe okwamanje.

reentry.crisisStep.en: Save these numbers now. You can also tap Need help now at the top of any screen.
reentry.crisisStep.draft: Gcina lezi zinombolo manje. Ungaphinde uthinte Udinga usizo manje phezulu kunoma isiphi isikrini.

reentry.steps.step14.en: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
reentry.steps.step14.draft: Bhala zonke izinsuku zokuqulwa kwecala nekhalenda

reentry.steps.step17.en: Check your fines, fees and restitution
reentry.steps.step17.draft: Hlola izinhlawulo zakho, izimali kanye nokubuyiselwa kwemali

reentry.steps.step19.en: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
reentry.steps.step19.draft: Bhalisa ku-Medicaid, futhi u-SNAP uma uyidinga

reentry.steps.step7.en: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
reentry.steps.step7.draft: Thola indawo ephephile ongahlala kuyo (shayela 211 noma izinsiza zokuhlala zendawo)

reentry.steps.step8.en: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
reentry.steps.step8.draft: Thola ukudla kwaleli sonto (shayela u-211 noma usebenzise i-food pantry yasendaweni)

safety.relapseDraft.en: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.relapseDraft.draft: Umklamo  ⁇  wokubuyekezwa. Izinyathelo zokuqala ezizohlala isikhathi esingangamahora angu-24 ngemva kokwehla kuzovela lapha uma usubuyekeziwe. Awuwedwa.

safety.vaultHelp.en: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.vaultHelp.draft: Imibhalo yakho ibethelwe. Isici sepulani elikhokhelwayo; ayikho intengo ebekiwe okwamanje.

support.resourcesNote.en: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.
support.resourcesNote.draft: Lolu hlu aluhlanganisi ukudla noma indawo yokuhlala.

wellbeing.roughHelp.en: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.roughHelp.draft: Akuwena wedwa. Inkinobho yezimo ezibucayi engenhla ihlale ilapha  ⁇  shayela noma uthumele umyalezo u-988, noma u-911 esimweni esiphuthumayo.

work.paroleNote.en: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.
work.paroleNote.draft: Qiniseka ukuthi uhlola izimo zakho ze-parole noma ze-probation nesikhulu sakho ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo.
